pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped dark brown polygonal regions are visible. On the cervical section, patches are elongated with rounded vertices, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed and angular geometries on the thoracic and lumbar flank areas. Edge gradients are moderately soft due to image resolution but maintain clear spatial boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored interstitial pathways separates the patches. The topological graph is characterized by high-frequency 3-way junction nodes and occasional 4-way nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform, approximately 10-15% of the adjacent patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark brown mane is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, creating a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background. The serration is consistent along the visible cervical segment.
